# Effex

A reactive UI framework built on Effect.ts primitives. Uses signals for state, derived values for computations, and represents DOM elements as Effects with automatic scope management.

## Installation

```bash
# For SPA (client-only)
pnpm add @effex/dom @effex/router effect

# For SSR (full-stack)
pnpm add @effex/platform effect
```

## Core Concepts

### Signals - Reactive State
```ts
const count = yield* Signal.make(0)
yield* count.get              // read: 0
yield* count.set(5)           // write
yield* count.update(n => n+1) // update
count.map(n => n * 2)         // derive a Readable
```

### Derived - Computed Values
```ts
// Synchronous
const doubled = yield* Derived.sync([count], ([n]) => n * 2)

// Asynchronous (with loading/error states)
const user = yield* Derived.async([userId], ([id]) => fetchUser(id))
```

### Elements - DOM as Effects

Use the `$` namespace for all HTML elements:

```ts
import { $ } from "@effex/dom"

// Elements are Effect<HTMLElement, E, Scope>
$.div({ class: "container" }, [
  $.h1("Hello"),
  $.p(count),  // Reactive - updates when count changes
  $.button({ onClick: () => count.update(n => n + 1) }, "+"),
])
```

### Components
```ts
const Counter: Component.Unit = () =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const count = yield* Signal.make(0)
    return yield* $.div([
      $.button({ onClick: () => count.update(n => n - 1) }, "-"),
      $.span(count),
      $.button({ onClick: () => count.update(n => n + 1) }, "+"),
    ])
  })
```

### Control Flow
```ts
// Conditional rendering
when(isLoggedIn, {
  onTrue: () => Dashboard(),
  onFalse: () => LoginForm(),
})

// Pattern matching
match(status, {
  cases: [
    { pattern: "loading", render: () => Spinner() },
    { pattern: "error", render: () => ErrorMessage() },
    { pattern: "success", render: () => Content() },
  ],
  fallback: () => $.div("Unknown"),
})

// Lists with keyed updates
each(todos, {
  container: () => $.ul({ class: "todo-list" }),
  key: todo => todo.id,
  render: (todoReadable) => TodoItem({ todo: todoReadable }),
})
```

### Error Handling
```ts
// Elements can have error channels: Element<E>
const riskyComponent: Element<FetchError> = Effect.gen(function* () {
  const data = yield* fetchData()  // may fail
  return yield* $.div(data.message)
})

// Handle errors before mounting
const safeComponent = Boundary.error(
  () => riskyComponent,
  (error) => $.div(["Error: ", String(error)])
)

// mount() requires Element<never> - all errors must be handled
yield* mount(safeComponent, document.getElementById("root")!)
```

### Async Boundaries
```ts
Boundary.suspense({
  render: () =>
    Effect.gen(function* () {
      const user = yield* fetchUser(id)
      return yield* UserProfile({ user })
    }),
  fallback: () => $.div("Loading..."),
  catch: (error) => $.div(`Error: ${error.message}`),
  delay: "200 millis",  // Avoid loading flash
})
```

### Mounting
```ts
import { mount, runApp } from "@effex/dom"

runApp(
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    yield* mount(App(), document.getElementById("root")!)
  })
)
```

## Key Types

- `Signal<A>` - Readable + writable reactive state
- `Readable<A>` - Read-only reactive value with `.get`, `.changes`, `.values`, `.map()`
- `Derived<A>` - Computed reactive value
- `Element<E = never>` - Effect<HTMLElement, E, Scope>
- `Child<E = never>` - Valid children: string, number, Element, Readable, or arrays
- `Component.Unit<R, E>` - Component with no props
- `Component.Leaf<Props, R, E>` - Component with props, no children
- `Component.Node<Props, ChildReqs, R, E>` - Component with optional children
- `Component.Branch<Props, ChildReqs, R, E>` - Component with required children

## Element Factories

The `$` namespace contains all HTML elements:

```ts
import { $ } from "@effex/dom"

$.div, $.span, $.p, $.h1-$.h6, $.button, $.input, $.form, $.label,
$.ul, $.ol, $.li, $.a, $.img, $.nav, $.header, $.footer, $.main,
$.section, $.article, $.aside, $.textarea, $.select, $.option,
$.table, $.thead, $.tbody, $.tr, $.th, $.td
```

Individual imports also available: `import { div, span } from "@effex/dom"`

## Attributes

```ts
$.div({
  class: "static-class",                    // or Readable<string>
  style: { color: "red", fontSize: "16px" }, // or Readable<Record>
  id: "my-id",
  onClick: (e) => Effect.log("clicked"),    // Event handlers can return Effects
  disabled: isDisabled,                      // boolean or Readable<boolean>
}, [children])
```

## Packages

- `@effex/core` - Reactive primitives (Signal, Derived, Readable)
- `@effex/dom` - DOM rendering, elements, control flow, components
- `@effex/router` - Type-safe routing
- `@effex/form` - Form handling with Effect Schema validation
- `@effex/platform` - Full-stack SSR framework (re-exports all packages)

## Patterns

### Fetching Data
```ts
const UserProfile: Component.Leaf<{ userId: string }> = (props) =>
  Boundary.suspense({
    render: () =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        const user = yield* fetchUser(props.userId)
        return yield* $.div([
          $.h1(user.name),
          $.p(user.email),
        ])
      }),
    fallback: () => $.span("Loading..."),
    catch: (error) => $.span(`Error: ${error.message}`),
  })
```

### Form Handling
```ts
const LoginForm: Component.Unit = () =>
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const email = yield* Signal.make("")
    const password = yield* Signal.make("")

    const handleSubmit = (e: SubmitEvent) =>
      Effect.gen(function* () {
        e.preventDefault()
        const emailVal = yield* email.get
        const passVal = yield* password.get
        yield* login(emailVal, passVal)
      })

    return yield* $.form({ onSubmit: handleSubmit }, [
      $.input({
        type: "email",
        value: email,
        onInput: (e) => email.set((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value),
      }),
      $.input({
        type: "password",
        value: password,
        onInput: (e) => password.set((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value),
      }),
      $.button({ type: "submit" }, "Login"),
    ])
  })
)
```

### Routing
```ts
import { Route, Router, Link, makeRouterLayer } from "@effex/router"

const routes = {
  home: Route.make("/"),
  user: Route.make("/users/:id"),
}

runApp(
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const router = yield* Router.make(routes)
    const routerLayer = makeRouterLayer(router)

    yield* mount(
      App().pipe(Effect.provide(routerLayer)),
      document.getElementById("root")!
    )
  })
)
```
